purpose: Pre-outcome calibration of the descriptive strict ranking flip screen, NOT actual-data inference or an altered gate
assumption: Artificial continuous IID exchangeable scores: two programs each measured twice in each of two independent resource conditions; no program or resource effect
boundary: Real program scores are neither IID nor generally equal in expectation; ABBA conditions were not randomized. These are not real p-values or estimated real false-positive rates. Strict repeated flip remains descriptive and needs a separately selected-program confirmation plus eventual equal-cost search benefit. No success threshold changed.
